sellThenNews.description: r/wallstreetbets 2026 年 6 月 5 日情绪分析。讨论最多的股票代码：AVGO、NVDA、MU、MRVL、AMD。人工智能生成的零售流程、牛市/熊市叙述和关键主题的摘要。

sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件：

  • May Non-Farm Payrolls Blowout, "Good News is Bad News": May non-farm payrolls added 172k, far exceeding the expected 80k–85k, with the unemployment rate holding steady at 4.3%. Strong employment was interpreted as the Fed having no need to cut rates, or potentially even raising them—the 10-year Treasury yield jumped to 4.53% intraday, the 2-year rose to 4.15%, and the probability of a rate hike by year-end surged from ~60% a week ago to ~85%. Interest rates have become the true engine of this valuation correction.
  • Semiconductor Epicenter: AVGO (Broadcom) plummeted ~12.6% in a single day, wiping out approximately $350 billion in market cap, after its Q3 AI chip guidance of $16 billion missed the market expectation of $17.2 billion and the company maintained its $100 billion annual target without an upward revision. This dragged down NVDA, AMD, MU, and MRVL, causing the tech sector to fall ~2.9% intraday.
  • Severe Divergence Between Indices and Individual Stocks: At the close, the S&P was only -0.63%, the Dow rose +0.07%, and the Nasdaq was -1.1% (after being down 2.2% intraday). Defensive sectors (Consumer Staples, Healthcare, Utilities) led the gains—this is a "rotation," not a "crash."
  • Trump Breaks Convention: After rushing to comment on the employment data pre-market, he posted: "With such good jobs, the stock market should be up, not down, it’s been that way for 200 years... growth does not equal inflation!" in an attempt to talk up the market.
  • Risk Assets Sell Off Across the Board: BTC fell below 60k, gold broke through its 200-day moving average (first time since 2023), silver became a joke, and oil prices fell despite the war backdrop—the "stocks-bonds-commodities-gold" simultaneous decline has left the market confused.

整体氛围：混乱且倾向于恐慌，表现出教科书式的背离——指数仅下跌约 1%，但动态中充斥着“破产声明”、“自杀热线机器人”和“下跌 30%”的帖子。杠杆和 0DTE 放大了对账户大屠杀的轻微修正。我估计社区恐惧/贪婪指数约为 80（高度恐慌），而实际市场接近 48（中性/避险）。 “逢低买入/等待 V 线/收盘时呈绿色”的逆势信念依然顽固，并已成为社区自我意识的一部分——“WSB 总体恐慌 = 买入机会”。

MSFT~28看跌（逆向图腾）“现代最差股票”，“新稳定币钉在420”；但今天“跌得最少”，防守属性矛盾
AAPL~20看涨（避险）板上只有长绿，“不管新闻如何都绿”，被视为婴儿潮一代的避风港
TSLA~15看跌P/E 386 仍未下降引人怀疑；摩根大通上调至中性适得其反；对资金流向SpaceX的担忧
MRVL~12看涨（事件驱动）押注 6/6 标准普尔纳入，需要收盘于 305 以上；雷曼估值升级； “SPY 总是在 300 分突破之前就倾倒”
AMD~10中性的受AVGO拖累，多头连连喊“到500”
MSTR~10看跌Saylor 未实现损失 ~11B+；提出“太容易”； “入狱/除名”嘲讽
PL~10看跌（超卖）Planet Labs 财报后-21%~25%，多空均称超卖
